tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i dkyil chog dbang rdo rje'i phreng ba bzhugs so//

na mo mū la gu ru ga ya dha rā ye/ 'dir byin rlabs nus pa drod tshad dang ldan pa'i bla mas dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma la lhan skyes bzhi'i dbang byin rlabs kyi cho ga ltar bskur ba ni/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs mkha' 'gro rgyu ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ yid dang mthun zhing rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas dur khrod la sogs par bris sku bkram zhing*/ bdud rtsi dang dris byugs pa'i maṇḍal sna tshogs pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar nyi gdan la/ lha'i mdog mthun gyi phyag mtshan gyi lte bar sa bon gyis mtshan pa bris pa'i nye logs su rin po che'i bum pa gnyis kha rgyan mgul chings dang ldan zhing lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa bshams shing mtha' mchod pas bskor/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ 'jig 'das kyi gtor ma tshogs rdzas rnams sta gon byas la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor nang mchod byin rlabs nas/ thun bsdu nas dpa' gcig tu ldang ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rdo rje'i ra gur 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i me ri dang bcas pa gsal ba'i lte bar bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhes pa der de ltar lha gang yin de nyid bskyed nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/

dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ= puṣpaṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai wi dye= shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ lag gnyis rnam lnga 'dod kor dang 'khyud rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go/ /lha yab yum gyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po| snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapad 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur te chu lhag ma las/ gsang 'dus kyi skabs yab yum gnyis la/ rdo rje 'chang gis dbu brgyan/ ces dang*/ bde mchog gi skabs/ bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan ces dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi skabs yab yum gnyis la/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ces dang*/ dus 'khor gyi skabs yab yum gnyis la/ rgyal ba lnga sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan/ ces dang*/ thun mong du/ dbang gi lha rnams lha yab yum la thim par gyur/ ces dang*/ de nas phyi mchod ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/

oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapad 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ lha yab yum gang yin gyi sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod thigs gtor 'bul/ gsang mchod ni/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pa'i dga' ba/ de nas snying ga'i bar mchog dga' ba/ de nas lte ba'i bar khyad par dga' ba/ de nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ brjod/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas bsgoms pas// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes gnas lugs bsgom| bstod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud| |thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud//

ces bstod la/ bskyed rim la mnyam par bzhag / lha yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las rang 'dra'i dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rang 'dra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon sngags phreng la thim zhing 'od 'bar bar gyur par dmigs nas sngags brgya stong gang thub bzla/ bum bskyed ni/ gtso bum gyi steng du dung chos dri'i chus bkang ba'i khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bkod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos gang zhing dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa gnyis las/ rnal rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad nyi sogs nas gyur gyi bar du mdun bskyed ltar lha gang yin yab yum bskyed/ las bum gyi nang du sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po bgegs mthar byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar shing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ brkyang bskum gyis 'gyings shing khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ khro rngam 'jigs par byed pa 'bar pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ de nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ snying khar nyi ma la nas/ las bum gyi lha la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la thim par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar dang*/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod/ rnal rgyal gyi lha yab yum la/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ sogs 'dud nyi shu dang*/ las bum la/ hūm̐é 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng spros pas gzung thag la brgyud de song ba bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing*/ rnam rgyal gyi lha yab yum rjes su chags pa'i snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang zhing*/ las bum gyi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs nas/ lha gang yin gyi sngags dang*/ mthar gzung thag rdo rje las bum gyi khar spos la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐ yang ci nus bzla/ mthar mchod cing*/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la/ lha rnams rjes su chags pa chen po zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces dung zhal gyi chu rnam rgyal du blug / las bum gyi lhas 'dir dbang ngam/ rab gnas sam/ sbyin sreg sogs skabs don gang yin bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig / ces gsol/ 'das pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar la/ khyad par ni lhan skyes re re ma gtogs dbang gi skabs lha bzhi ga la cho ga gcig gis mi 'grub pas lha gang yin gyi sngags kyis 'bul ba sogs sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ de rjes 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang sgrub thabs ltar 'bul zhing*/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar sgrubs thabs ltar bya/ bdag nyid 'jug pa ni las bum gyis khrus bya ba nas/ gtang rag gi bar slob mar dbang bskur ltar la/ khyad par ni dkyil 'khor pas slob dpon dang*/ de las rang 'dra ba spros pas las kyi rdo rje mdzad par bsam/ slob ma zhes pa'i mal du rang nyid ces 'don pa spos shing slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gi byas pas 'grub bo/ / de nas slob ma gzhug pa ni/ slob ma rnams las thams cad pas khrus bya/

gral la bkod/ me tog bkram nas maṇḍal phul la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo| |dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab cing*/ thun mong du sems bskyed cing rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags| |'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum bya/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa gzung ba ni/ slob mas de 'dzin 'dod kyi bsam pa dang bcas pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// de kho na nyid gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ oṃ tsakṣurbahandha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐ gis mig dar g.yogs// a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad| khyad par sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/ don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par bsams la/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ zhes sems bskyed/ de nyid brtan phyir slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying khar bzhag nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas / oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum gyis phyag bya/ dam chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ slob ma'i mgo'am lag tu rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ gal te byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/
zhes brjod cing bsgrags/ ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/

gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes su āḥlas byung ba'i gsung rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po g.yas padma dang*/ g.yon des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs pa'i snying khar laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su zla ba la haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i zla ba la āḥdamar po/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum yi ge ras mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos slob ma 'degs bzhin pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis thugs gsung sku'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs la de rnams kyi rang bzhin hūm̐ ha āḥ'i yi ge rnams la bstim zhing rkang pa'i bu ga nas dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa dang hūm̐ la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar gyur par bsam shing*/ ā we sha ya/ st+waṃ bha ya st+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ ha āḥdzhaiḥ zhes rnam par brgyar 'don zhing bsam gtan la gzhol ba'i dril bu gsil zhing*/ bud med kyi 'doms dkris zla mtshan gyis sbags pa dang*/ byi la'i brun/ yi dwags kyi kha nas byung ba'i gu gul| sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams thod phor du ro sol gyi me la bsregs nas bdug go// tiṣṭha badzra dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ slob mas me tog dor zhing*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ pra tītstsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ zhes dor/ me tog gang du bab pa'i mchog dman bar mar lung bstan/ slar me tog slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgor bcings la/

oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ mig dbye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*// khyod gyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad// oṃ dzñā na tsakṣuḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes mig dar bsal| bcom ldan 'das che ge'i dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mthong par bsam/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug pa slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar bab pa bcom ldan 'das che ge mo lhan skyes mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab pa padma nas phyung mdun du dbang stegs la 'khod par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba'i skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol pa btab pa'i tshe/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ dbang lha bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes lnga'i chus gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis khyod rang gi steng phyogs su gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa 'dzin cing me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa la/ slob mas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig

/ ces gsol ba btab pa la dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥbadzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te st+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bskur/ 'dir rig dbang gzhan bzhi'i tshab tu/ bum pa nyid mgo bo'i phyogs bzhi dang dbus rnams su bzhag nas bum chu sbyin no// de dag gis slob ma'i nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs/ phung po lnga gnas bsgyur/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor byas shing*/ rgyal ba lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /slar mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha dang slob dpon la bdag po'i dbang gi don du/ slob mas/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don byed nus 'gyur// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa'i tshe dbang lhas rdo rje dril bu bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ slob dpon gyis slob mar rdor dril gtad la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes g.yas dang*/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe hoḥ zhes g.yon du gtad/ slob mas 'khyud rgya byas la/ slob dpon gyis/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ zhes brjod brtan phyir chu dbang ni/ sngar spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas bum pa'i chus/ oṃ āḥbadzrod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te st+waṃ a haṃ/

zhes dbang bskur/ de'i tshe slob mas bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ chu lhag ma las slob ma lhar gsal ba'i dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung*| ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon du don grub/ spyi bor rnam snang*/ bde dgyes gsang gsum la longs sku'i cha lugs can rang 'dra'i yum dang sbyor ba/ dus 'khor la sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan| dbang lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor slob ma la bstim/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ sngags gtad pa ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gnyis mched kyi tshul du zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas pa nas zhugs snying khar 'khor bar bsam la/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ lha'i sngags rnams lan gsum bzla bar bya'o// de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis phyi mtshan bcas kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ thun mong ba lus kyis gtso bor bsags pa'i las gsum gyi dri ma sngar bsags pa byang zhing phyi ma bsdam/ thun mong ma yin pa lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma 'khrud sprul sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mngon du gyur pa'i skal pa can du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ maṇḍal 'bul/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ slob mas/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod| | ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ bla mas/ lhan skyes gang yin gyi yab dang rig ma yum dang*/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rnams sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab/ snyoms 'jug gis rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa bkug

/bdag gi zhal du bcug pas chags pa chen pos zhu ba dhū ti nas brgyud mkha' gsang du bab pa rang gi byang sems dang 'dres pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhu ba'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bdud rtsi mkha' gsang du bab par gyur/ slob ma rab kyis mkha' gsang nas lces blangs/ 'bring gis slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis blangs pa slob ma'i lcer bzhag /tha ma la thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang bsres khar sbyin dgos la/ 'di'i rab 'bring ni slob ma rtog pa 'joms pa rab sogs so// de'i tshe bla mas/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi// zhes brjod cing sbyin/ slob mas myangs shing*/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ mig dar bsal/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ thun mong ba ngag gi las bzhi'i dri ma sngar bsags pa byang zhing phyi ma bsdam| thun mong ma yin pa las rlung gi dri ma 'khrud/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /lam bdag byin rlabs kyi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes rtogs pa brjod/ maṇḍal phul/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ slob mas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong bcing*/ slob dpon gyis rig ma mtshan ldan gyi lag g.yon pa nas bzung ba slob ma'i g.yas su gtad la/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo rig ma'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ */nor bu'i nang du chud pa ltar/ */

gang de skyes gyur ye shes kyi// ye shes de ni ngo bor dmigs// zhes gtad cing*/ slob ma lhan skyes gang yin yab dang*/ rig ma yum dang*/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas rjes/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms 'jug bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas byang sems smin mtshams nas mgrin par bab pas dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ nor bu lhan skyes dang de'i tshe slob ma lhar gsal ba'i snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum rnams bkug pa| kha nas zhugs pas lus byin gyis brlabs shing bla mas kyang rgyal ba yab yum spyan drangs pa rnams slob ma yab yum gyi lus la bcug pa dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i tshe slob mas nus pa ji lta bar bzung la/ ma zin na dal bus btang la chu skyes nas lces blangs te de kho na nyid kyi bsam pas dam tshig gi ngo bo byang sems btung bar bya'o// de nas mig dar bsal/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thun mong ba yid kyi las gsum gyi dri ma sngar bsags pa byang zhing phyi ma bsdam/ thun mong ma yin pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ chos kyi sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /lam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed maṇḍal phul/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal 'bul la/ slob mas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*| |bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar g.yogs sam mi g.yogs gang byas kyang*/ bla mas/ shes rab ye shes de nyid myu gur gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas rab tu 'phel bzhin pa/

sgrib pa med pa nyid du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin can de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes yin la/ de'ang dbang gsum pa'i skabs su ngo sprad pa'i lhan skyes shes rab ye shes de nyid don gyi lhan skyes kyi 'bras bu myu gu lta bu yin la/ de lta bu byang chub kyi sems de ni sgom pa ste goms par byas pas gong nas gong du rab tu 'phel bzhin pa las/ sgrib pa thams cad zad pas med pa nyid du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku dang*/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bdag nyid dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin can gang yin pa de ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin pas rtogs par byos shig / ces brjod| spro na dpe'i sgo nas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes dang*/ de'i don rgyas par brjod/ mig dar bsal/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyod kyis don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ thun mong ba sgo gsum ga'i dri ma phra mo bag chags dang bcas pa sngar bsags pa byang shing phyi ma bsdam/ thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi dri ma gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog phra mo rnams 'khrud/ ngo bo nyid sku bde ba chen po'i sku'i nus pa khyad par can 'jog /lam phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje gsum ro mnyam pa'i ye shes rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/

dam tshig bsrung ba'i sems kyis/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul/ tshogs kyi mchod pa bya bar spro na/ ma da na la sogs pa shes rab kyi rdzas rnams g.yon dang*/ sha zan la sogs pa'i thabs kyi rdzas rnams g.yas dang*/ khu ra sogs g.yos sbyar gyi rdzas rnams dbus su bzhag par nang mchod bran nas/ sgrub thabs kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ sha zan sogs tshogs rdzas rnams kyi phud nas cung zad re bris sku sogs kyi drung du phul nas/ ma da na sogs sgron la/ hūm̐é gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// dgyes pa mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*| |yi dam lhan skyes rnam bzhi la// so sor byed na yi dam gsang ba 'dus pa la/ sogs phral bar bya'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba dang*// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la// bstan srung rgya mtshos bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med pa bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

zhes dbul/ las kyi rdo rjes lag g.yas ma da na'i snod thogs/ g.yon ba dan gyi rgya bstan la/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi phag gdol pa bcas// lhan cig mnyam pa'i dbyings su rol// ces slob dpon la drangs shing*/ slob dpon gyi rnam lnga 'dod kor gyis/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la bdag 'dud do// zhes blangs/ de nas mched lcam rnams la drangs shing bag dang ldan pas longs spyad/ dam tshig gcig pa kho na'i lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya kha'i thad du brkyangs pa'i dbus nas su ra'i kha phru btab la/ a kā ro bdun dang*/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa pa ti sarba bhū ta bhakṣa swā hā/ zhes gtsang sar dor/ bum mdun gyi lha la mchod cing bstod nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa// mgon pos de kun bzod par mdzod// ces dang*/ he ru ka'i yig brgyas bskang*/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam| phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing*/ smon lam gyis rgyas gdab/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// dkyil chog 'di kho bos bgyis pa'i bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub thabs kyi dbang la'ang sbyar bar rung ngo*// zhes pa'ang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spros pa cher gsungs pa rnams deng sang gi rdo rje slob dpon du rlom pa rnams kyi blo mtshor ma spobs pas/

gzu lum ras gcod kho nar 'dug pas/ 'dir blo dman gyi slob dpon dang slob ma rnams 'jug pa bde bar snying po rnams bsdus nas dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga 'di yang*/ 'bri gung pa gsang ba sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ lcags lug zla ba bcu pa'i dkar cha'i rdzogs pa dang po la/ dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen por sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs pa ste yi ge pa ni mnga' ris pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bgyis pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
